title: Helios Console — Credentials
description: Secrets tier of the Helios Console managed configuration. Preference domain: com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.credentials — deploy as its own Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings profile. Holds ONLY secrets so they can be rotated independently of the other Helios profiles. SECURITY: managed-preference plists are world-readable on disk — scope tightly, use least-privilege API roles, rotate on any suspected exposure. Scope write-capable variants to the same Macs as the access profile granting the matching admin role. No secret has a default; set real values in Jamf and never commit them to source control.

configurationVersion.description: Schema version for compatibility checking (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it)

jamfProClientSecret.title: Jamf Pro Master API Client Secret
jamfProClientSecret.description: OAuth client_secret for the master Jamf Pro API client (pairs with jamfPro.masterClientID in the core profile). Required — Helios cannot authenticate without it. Enter the real value directly in Jamf.

abmPrivateKey.title: Apple Business Manager Private Key (PEM)
abmPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded ES256 private key for ABM JWT signing (pairs with appleBusinessManager.clientID and keyID in the core profile). Optional — omit if ABM is unused. Paste the full PEM string including the BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY lines.

jamfProtectPassword.title: Jamf Protect API Password (Client Secret)
jamfProtectPassword.description: Jamf Protect API client password (pairs with jamfProtect.clientID in the core profile). Optional: if delivered, the in-app password field locks; if omitted, the app falls back to in-app entry stored in the Keychain.
